cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The little demon's eating our crossword. I'll feed it something else; keep the lease out of reach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It appeared when you read that novelty mug aloud.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sequence isn't proof. Put the lease higher, please. I'll find it something less important.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's climbing the shelf. It only wants things with words on them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the mug. I'll put it between the demon and the lease. Don't waste time copying the inscription; I know what I'm doing.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 sequence correction hides the mug cause and A5 offers it to save the lease; the final copying prohibition is not prompted by B.
